title: Lossless Strichartz estimates on rectangular tori over short time intervals
summary: We prove lossless Strichartz estimates at the critical exponent $q_c = \frac{2(n+1)}{n-1}$ and the endpoint exponent pair $\left(2,\frac{2(n-1)}{n-3}\right)$ for the Schrödinger equation on rectangular tori of dimension $n-1$ with frequency localized initial data on small time windows with length depending on the frequency parameter $λ\gg 1$.
